data.text/markdown:
Activation View

The projection above uses the raw 4-D state as input. Clusters reflect physical similarity (similar cart positions, pole angles). Below we re-project using the penultimate-layer activations of the trained Q-network instead.

LunarLander DQN

Environment Inputs

  1. x position
  2. y position
  3. x velocity
  4. y velocity
  5. lander angle
  6. angular velocity
  7. left leg contact (0 or 1)
  8. right leg contact (0 or 1)
